## Why This Is Asked

- PII redaction via Text Analytics

- Data lake auditing and end-to-end data lineage

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo-code: build a prompt with retrieved docs and redaction
async function buildPrompt(query, tenantId, k){
  const docs = await searchKB(query, tenantId, k); // Cognitive Search

  return `Context: ${redacted}\nQuestion: ${query}`;
}
```
